issue_context.title: Unnecessarily Exported MaxInt in scheduler api types
issue_context.body:
MaxInt const is exported in scheduler api https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/6cb788c80e93bf0292f0a846ff1b55f690fcc970/pkg/scheduler/api/types.go#L31 although it is not needed to be exported. It is only used by `plugins_test.go`.

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/81263#discussion_r317606153 discussed that the common practice is to have API constants in `defaults.go`

/sig scheduling
comments: The problem is that it is part of a v1 API :(
Ok, it turns out they are not actually considered part of the API, and so we can remove them: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/82283#issuecomment-528952678
@ahg-g Should I open a PR to address removing those const values from `types.go`?
Yes, we can remove those in a followup PR to the one handling sized values.

review_comments: MaxTotalPriority can stay since it has specific meaning, we may change all of that when we move to Score plugins in the scheduler.

I agree with @ahg-g on this, MaxTotalPriority defines a meaning in addition of being equal to MaxInt64 (as it could change or something). Updating it now. 

@Huang-Wei  let me know if you have any further thoughts on this.
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/82732/files#diff-7f99c089b0b9494f4e4dea69979798c2L38 should use MaxTotalPriority instead of MaxInt64
doesn't it make sense to change the line I referenced as well to `MaxTotalPriority`

> doesn't it make sense to change the line I referenced as well to `MaxTotalPriority`

yes it does.
Should other consts be moved outside `types.go` as well? Where should they belong then?

We can leave them here as this package isn't supposed to be exposed as external API. Instead, 
 the package under `staging` will be exposed.
